verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workflows lets developers define multi-step, durable code that automatically retries failed tasks, persists state for minutes to weeks, and pauses for external events, without manually wiring queues/retries infrastructure (cloudflare-docs-27, cloudflare-docs-41, cloudflare-docs-42, cloudflare-docs-9). This is backed by Durable Objects-based Agents SDK for stateful long-running execution (cloudflare-supp-agents-sdk) and community corroboration that Workers/agents can run persistent stateful workloads, though one community comment flags CPU-time limits as a constraint for very long-running agent tasks (cloudflare-comm-9). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of Workflows specifically (vs. just docs) and clearer detail on how retry/backoff policies are configured.
